Practical Guidance

How to use herbal remedies well

Herbs work differently to pharmaceuticals — gently, cumulatively, and best when used with intention. Here is how to get the most from each format.

01Herbal Teas & Infusions
Use 1–2 tsp of herb per cup, or follow pack instructions for our blended teas.
Pour freshly boiled water over the herbs and cover to retain volatile oils.
Steep leaves & flowers 5–10 minutes; steep roots & barks 15–20 minutes or longer.
Strain and drink warm. Most teas are best taken 1–3 times daily, away from meals.
02Liquid Tonics
Shake well before each use — natural settling is normal and expected.
Take the recommended dose neat, or diluted in a small amount of water or juice.
For detox tonics, taking one dose on rising and one before bed is traditional.
Refrigerate after opening and use within 4–6 weeks for best potency.
03Salves & Topical Gels
Apply a small amount to clean, dry skin and massage gently until absorbed.
For pain relief, apply 2–3 times daily directly to the affected area.
For skincare gels, use sparingly on blemish-prone areas, ideally at night.
Always patch test a new topical on your inner arm 24 hours before full use.
04Powders & Elixirs
Mix 1 tablespoon into 8–10oz of milk, water, or a smoothie, once daily.
Taking with a meal containing healthy fat can improve absorption of fat-soluble compounds.
Consistency matters more than timing — pick a time of day you'll remember and stick with it.
05Building Consistency
Herbal remedies work cumulatively — most people notice change within 2–6 weeks.
Take your remedy at the same time each day to build a sustainable habit.
Track how you feel weekly rather than daily — herbal change is gradual, not dramatic.
06When to Pause or Stop
Stop and consult a GP if you notice any unexpected skin reaction, rash, or digestive upset.
Pause internal tonics 1–2 weeks before any planned surgery.
If symptoms worsen or persist beyond 8 weeks, seek professional guidance rather than continuing alone.
Safety First

Interactions & safety guidance

Herbal medicine is powerful and should be respected. Please read this section carefully before beginning any new herbal product.

✅
Generally Well Tolerated
  • Most adults can use our topical salves and gels without issue
  • Herbal teas in normal culinary quantities are widely safe
  • Patch testing new topicals reduces risk of reaction
  • Starting with a lower dose lets you gauge your sensitivity
⚠️
Use With Care
  • Combining 3+ new herbal products at once makes reactions hard to trace
  • Diabetics should monitor blood sugar closely with Cinnamon & Turmeric-containing formulas
  • Those on blood thinners should discuss Turmeric & Ginger with their doctor
  • Cayenne-containing topicals can cause warmth/irritation on broken skin
🚫
Avoid If
  • Pregnant or breastfeeding — avoid Cascara Sagrada, Cayenne & St John's Wort internally
  • Taking SSRIs, blood thinners or contraceptive pills — St John's Wort interacts significantly
  • Under 18 — consult a paediatric herbalist or GP before any internal herbal product
  • Scheduled for surgery within 2 weeks — pause all internal tonics
💬
Always Tell Us If You
  • Take any prescription medication, especially blood thinners or antidepressants
  • Have a diagnosed liver, kidney, or autoimmune condition
  • Are pregnant, trying to conceive, or breastfeeding
  • Have known allergies to any plant in the daisy (Asteraceae) family

This information is educational and does not replace professional medical advice. Our products are not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease. Always consult your healthcare provider before beginning any new herbal regimen, particularly if pregnant, nursing, or taking medication.

Where it began

A search for something real

It started, as so many honest things do, with frustration. Frustrated with wellness products that promised everything and explained nothing. Frustrated with ingredient lists that read like chemistry homework.

We went back to basics — and back to scripture. Genesis 1:29 tells us plainly that every seed-bearing herb was given to us. Ezekiel 47:12 describes leaves whose purpose is medicine. These were not poetic ideas to us; they became the foundation of how we formulate.

Wisdom Optimal Health was born from that conviction. From hours spent studying traditional herbalism, sourcing ingredients with real transparency, and formulating with one simple principle: every plant earns its place, or it doesn't go in.

🌿About Our Products

Yes — every product we make uses only botanical ingredients: dried herbs, plant extracts, carrier oils, and naturally derived compounds. We do not use synthetic preservatives, artificial fragrances, or chemical stabilisers.

What it means practically: a shorter shelf life than conventional products, and occasional natural variation in colour or texture between batches.

All Wisdom Optimal Health products are formulated by a qualified herbalist and reviewed for safety prior to release. We follow applicable UK cosmetic and food supplement regulations.

Herbal medicine works gently and cumulatively. Most customers begin noticing meaningful change within 2–6 weeks of consistent use.

We ground our work in Genesis 1:29, where God gives every seed-bearing herb for our nourishment, and Ezekiel 47:12, which speaks of leaves whose purpose is medicine. These aren't decorative quotes for us — they shape how we view and respect every botanical we use.

📋Using Our Products

In many cases, yes — our products are designed to be used alongside each other. We recommend starting two or three new herbal products with care to monitor your response.

We strongly advise against using our internal formulas during pregnancy or breastfeeding without prior consultation with your midwife, GP, or a qualified herbalist.

Herbal medicines can interact with pharmaceutical drugs. If you take any prescribed medication, please consult your GP or pharmacist before starting any new herbal supplement.

📦Orders, Delivery & Returns

UK orders are typically dispatched within 1–2 business days and delivered within 3–5 business days via Royal Mail Tracked.

Yes — free standard UK delivery on all orders over £40. Orders under £40 incur a flat £3.50 delivery charge.

If your product arrives damaged or incorrect, contact us within 7 days for a replacement or refund. We cannot accept returns of opened products for hygiene reasons unless there is a genuine fault.

What is Coaching?

Not advice. Not therapy. Transformation.

Coaching is a powerful, forward-focused process that helps you get clarity on what you truly want, identify what's holding you back, and take meaningful action toward the life you're meant to live.

Unlike therapy (which explores the past) or consulting (which gives answers), coaching empowers you to find your own answers. I ask the right questions. You discover the right path.

Integrated with holistic wellness, herbal support and a faith-rooted perspective, this is coaching that sees the whole person — not just the problem in front of them.
